    • forTarget

      public static Optional<MappingWriter> forTarget(String target)
      Resolves a target format named either way, so that a caller - a command line above all - can say xml or .mapping.xml and mean the same writer.
      Parameters:
      target - a format id or a file extension
      Returns:
      the writer producing it, empty if none on the classpath does

    • formats

      Returns:

    • requireKeysAndValues

      public static void requireKeysAndValues(List<? extends Mapping> mappings)
      Rejects entries without a key or a value, which the model tolerates - a Groovy script may declare (null) : 'x' - but no file format can state. Writers call this before writing anything, so that a mapping file is never produced that its own loader rejects.
      Parameters:
      mappings - the mappings to be written
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - naming the first mapping with such an entry
